instructions: Template for bulk-generating FAQ content for injector.world. Read the fields and referenceData sections below, then fill the faqs array with your generated FAQ objects (see the exact shape in fields). Save as .json and upload it on the FAQs admin page. Uploaded FAQs are staged as pending review and only go live after an admin approves them. This file intentionally has no example rows, only schema and reference data.

question.description: The FAQ question, plain text, no markdown.

answer.description: 40 to 80 words ideal, plain text, no markdown. Calm, factual, expert tone. No fear-based language, no hype, no em dashes.

scope.description: Controls which page(s) this FAQ can appear on. See referenceData.scopeRules below for what each value means and which ones are actually live on the site today.

serviceTag.description: The exact service or brand name as it appears in referenceData.validServiceOrBrandNames, for example 'Botox' or 'Lip Filler'. Use the display name with correct spacing and capitalization, not a URL slug (e.g. 'Lip Filler', not 'lip-filler'). Matching is case-insensitive but must contain the exact words.

cityTag.description: Meaning depends on scope. If scope is 'city', this is a real city display name, for example 'New York', 'Houston', 'Miami' (must match how the city is named on the site, not a slug). If scope is 'clinic', this must be one of referenceData.validClinicTypes exactly (e.g. 'medspa'), not a city name.

relatedGuideSlug.description: The slug of an existing guide from referenceData.validGuideSlugs, for example 'botox-cost'. Currently only used by the AI assistant to suggest a guide link in chat answers (mainly for homepage-scope FAQs). It is not shown on the plain FAQ accordion on service/city/clinic pages yet. Leave blank if not applicable.

sortRank.description: Lower numbers show first within the same scope/tag group.

stableId.pattern: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only, e.g. botox-cost-per-unit
stableId.description: A short unique id for this FAQ. Leave blank and one is generated automatically from the question. Re-uploading with the same stableId later updates that FAQ instead of creating a duplicate, so set this explicitly if you plan to revise this batch later.

scopeRules.homepage: Live. Shown on the homepage and used by the AI search assistant. serviceTag optional (e.g. tag it 'Botox' if the question is Botox-specific), cityTag and relatedGuideSlug rarely needed here.
scopeRules.service: Live. Shown on service/treatment pages. Requires serviceTag set to a value from validServiceOrBrandNames.
scopeRules.city: Live. Shown on city hub pages. Requires cityTag set to a real city name. serviceTag optional to narrow it to one service in that city.
scopeRules.clinic: Live. Shown on clinic profile pages, matched by clinic type. Requires cityTag set to a value from validClinicTypes (not a real city despite the field name).
scopeRules.guide: Defined in the system but no page currently queries scope 'guide'. Do not use this value yet, it will not appear anywhere until a founder wires it up.
